checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run test && pnpm --dir apps/control-panel/runtime run test
checks.proves: Field composition/session/readiness and related Control Panel tests execute.
checks.passCriteria: Relevant tests pass with negative cases.
checks.failCriteria: Any wrong-role/suspended/revoked scenario passes incorrectly or command fails.

checks.command: RUNTIME: provision field actor; exercise active/pending/incomplete/suspended/missing/revoked, logout, restart and deep-link before readiness
checks.proves: Identity→Workforce→app-field trust chain works end to end.
checks.passCriteria: Only valid active field actor reaches governed work and all invalid states fail closed.
checks.failCriteria: Any stale or invalid actor reaches governed field work.
